summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K reporting routine daily ASX disclosures tied to its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program, covering both Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) shares. No new authorization, price, stake or premium was stated; the exhibits merely reproduce buyback transaction information previously furnished to the Australian Securities Exchange. No advisor, board recommendation, close date or structural change accompanied the filing. The program remains discretionary and subject to market conditions, securities laws and alternative investment opportunities. Watch for actual repurchase pace, aggregate spend against the $1 billion cap, and any acceleration that signals management's valuation view.
